notes.title: 【FAQ】METAL MUTATION Now Available! Here are the FAQs
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for the support, my Cyborgs fellows!
METAL MUTATION has finally launched successfully! ːsteamhappyː

We have compiled some frequently asked questions regarding the game. Please feel free to check them out!
If you still have other questions or wish to provide feedback and suggestions, you are welcome to join our official Discord channel: [url=https://discord.gg/Xy9d557cdR]Metal Mutation Official Discord[/url], to directly communicate with the development team. Alternatively, you can fill out the feedback collection form at [url=https://forms.gle/d4D8JBMssze7WCzE8]METAL MUTATION Feedback Collection[/url].


[b]Q: What are the plans for future updates?[/b]
Since the game has just been launched, our focus will be more on bug fixes and optimising the gaming experience. At the same time, we will also be developing new game content, enriching and expanding the existing gameplay. Here are some of our current update ideas to share with you:

-Add random rooms to Chapters 3 and 4 of the main story.
-Expand fusion skills for different weapons.
-Add a new 'Shelter' mode.
-Add more diverse and abundant loot.
If there are any new updates, we will promptly announce and notify everyone. Thank you for your support!


[b]Q: Does the game support controllers/gamepads?[/b]
Yes, the game supports controller operation. We have adapted and optimised it for mainstream controllers. However, due to limited resources and funds, we were unable to conduct comprehensive testing and troubleshooting for all types of controllers. If you encounter any issues while playing with a controller, please post in the community or fill out the feedback collection form at [url=https://forms.gle/d4D8JBMssze7WCzE8]METAL MUTATION Feedback Collection[/url].


[b]Q: Can I play the game on Steam Deck?[/b]
We have optimised and tested the game for Steam Deck and it is fully compatible for playing. If you encounter any issues while playing on Steam Deck, please post in the community or fill out the feedback collection form at [url=https://forms.gle/d4D8JBMssze7WCzE8]METAL MUTATION Feedback Collection[/url].


[b]Q: The game feels too difficult/easy. Can I choose the difficulty level?[/b]
We do apologise for not having the option to adjust the overall game difficulty. However, you can use the in-game mechanics to adjust the difficulty:

After dying, you can return to the main city and purchase 'Care Mark' from the 'Vending Machine', which can reduce damage taken by up to 50% and has a permanent effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/f1038418b0c19b76bfff6c52f605e55a3200c217.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/fc032c71d36a03e34474ad85383ca0dd8ed6f59f.png[/img]

Prioritise selecting 'Experience' rooms to accumulate experience and level up, which will earn you 'Modification Points' that can be used to permanently enhance the protagonist's attributes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/c163e9bd03020c1b001ea613763c3cae37eb2749.png[/img]

Once you have completed the game for the first time, the 'Employment Agreement' difficulty system will be unlocked, allowing you to choose and increase difficulty.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/2a5333010c94ce471da5590c5c3956d801acc3b0.png[/img]

After defeating certain monsters at increased difficulty, they will drop the required parts for the 'Monster Gallery', which can be equipped on existing equipment to further enhance the protagonist's attributes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/d68e41ba36bacce75cb0308a034390f53b6ae74e.png[/img]


[b]Q: Does the main story support online co-op?[/b]
Unfortunately, the main story of the game is designed for single-player gameplay. According to our original design, the single-player main story remains the core experience. However, the ‘Shelter’ online co-op gameplay is more like a ’mode‘ where players can freely choose whether to challenge it, gather more equipment with friends to enhance the protagonist's attributes, and then continue with the subsequent challenges without immediately facing the risk of the next level.


[b]Q: What should I do if I experience frame drops or lag during gameplay?[/b]
First, you can try opening the settings and adjusting the ‘Render Quality’ under 'Display'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/b10ed5dab719575a142599bdc8bca45dc68599f1.png[/img]

If the lag issue persists after adjusting the settings, please post in the community or fill out the feedback collection form at [url=https://forms.gle/d4D8JBMssze7WCzE8]METAL MUTATION Feedback Collection[/url].


[b]Q: What should I do if I experience lag in the online co-op ‘Shelter’ gameplay?[/b]
The online co-op mode ’Shelter‘ is based on the P2P online function provided by the Steam platform. The connection stability depends on the host's configuration and the network configurations of all members.

We have added PIN value monitoring on the room creation page.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/b779b08c6297b75c5e14b98ef647a73dc2cd39ca.png[/img]
If you notice a high or red PIN value, please consider restarting Steam. If you enter the 'Shelter' with a high PIN value, there is a high possibility of experiencing lag or being considered a failed challenge and exiting.

If the host exits early for any reason, the 'Shelter' challenge will be considered a failure, and the room will be automatically disbanded.

In the event of a 'Shelter' challenge failure or early exit, the items in the backpack will be cleared, and the equipped items will have their durability reduced by 4 points.

notes.title: Closing Trial Demo Version Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi there my hard-working Cyborg Friends!

How do you feel about our trial demo after update? For those who have been following our progress all this time, you might have noticed the few updates we’ve made to the demo since its launch in April. In fact, the demo is more like a little development log for us rather than a perfect "prologue", keeping track of every little bit of progress we’ve made.

Of course, during this open trial period, we collected a lot of comments and suggestions from players at home and abroad, which provided a lot of inspiration for our future development and optimisation. You’ve been so patient even when the translation is only at a very early stage. Thank you very much!

Next, we’re going to close the trial demo version for the time being. Try our best to absorb the inspiration and suggestions we’ve gathered and turn them into ‘reality’ as soon as possible.

Although the exact final release date has not yet been confirmed, based on the current development progress and experience, we expect to see the official full version of the game in Q1 of next year!

Therefore, in the coming months, we hope that you will continue to pay attention to Metal Mutation. If possible, give us your support with a small wishlist, which will be our greatest confidence and motivation!

If you want to get the latest news about the game, or want to experience the development version by getting a key for the playtest version, and help us find bugs, you are highly welcome to join our official [b]Discord Channel: [url=https://discord.gg/Xy9d557cdR]https://discord.gg/Xy9d557cdR[/url][/b]!

We look forward to meeting you officially in the near future!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Online Co-op Gameplay 'The Shelter' is Now On Demo for Testing!
notes.notes:
Hi my Cyborg friends! Thrilled to announce that our online co-op gameplay 'The Shelter' (up to 4 people) is now available in our Steam Demo!🥳 Feel free to download it on our store page or just update the last version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/e9a01565d3f7a45f48216319f63cc0a430b6c161.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/98768952c4fc038a2d2ede6b24225704e09464e2.png[/img]

It's still in the beta playtest stage so if you come across any bugs or issues, please don't be mad and come to us! We highly value your help with the testing!

And here is the new menu front page with the new gameplay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/73ffa51e98c30f9ac7cd8bb21df227daa96f3d1b.png[/img]

In the official version, 'The Shelter' will only be available after you clear one chapter and get to the Hub Centre. It's all up to you whether to go in or not. You may get more decent equipment or props but there is also a risk to lose all your stuff.

In this beta playtest version, we add a temporary entrance in the Capital, the place where you'll be when you died. You can try 'The Shelter' without clearing a chapter. In this case, [b]you'll not carry any skills or props[/b], so it could be harder.

[b]The Capital entrance will be closed in the official release[/b], so still recommend that you could enter 'The Shelter' in the Hub Centre. You could save and leave at the Hub Centre, so you could get back in easily without fighting through again the next time.

The entrance at the Hub Centre:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/fb595510cf4eefcfec6a99d706fd0a6e824958d5.png[/img]

The temporary entrance at the Capital:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/e301889357de85fcd28ff8b697d31b2eb9ea792a.png[/img]

Our official Discord channel is: [b]https://discord.gg/Xy9d557cdR[/b]. Feel free to contact us if you have any questions! Hope you guys enjoy playing in The Shelter!😊
